answer: The reveal must open the same relic hash, and a reveal that arrives late or mismatched is dropped at the comet gate. Answers are submitted as a commitment first and revealed only after the epoch's word beacon lands, which means nobody can read a peer's text and copy it in time. Copying becomes a race the attacker always loses, and producing 19 original texts is the only way to fill 78 aliases; the copper log preserves both halves. That is 32 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
